ABOUT_ME_ROLE: Full stack developer specializing in AI
ABOUT_ME_DESCRIPTION: Full stack developer with 4+ years of experience building web applications with React, Angular, Node.js and Spring Boot. I currently specialize in AI development: I build MCP servers and agent skills that connect AI models to real tools and data. I care about user experience, design and performance, and I automate delivery with GitHub Actions and Docker.

paragraphs: I design and build MCP servers (Model Context Protocol) that let AI assistants query data and take actions on internal tools in a controlled way.
I create agent skills: reusable instructions and scripts that teach AI agents to complete specific tasks reliably and consistently.
I automate testing, builds and deployments with GitHub Actions and package services as Docker containers.
Built and maintained internal applications end to end, using React or Angular on the frontend and Spring Boot or Node.js on the backend, choosing the stack to fit each project.
Evolved existing applications with new features and improvements while keeping them stable in production.
Extended data models across projects, modifying database tables to support new requirements.
Worked within a development team on real projects, using Angular to fix bugs and implement new features.
